result.note: Tests DRDO's September 2026 source-code sharing framework, India's semiconductor commitments, and the Dholera supplier park.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about the framework launched by the Defence Research and Development Organisation (DRDO) in September 2026:
items: It allows licensed private firms to access the source code of weapon software.
Under it, DRDO handed 13 technology-transfer agreements to nine firms.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 2 is wrong. DRDO handed nine technology-transfer agreements to 13 firms, part of more than 2,300 transfers to date. The source-code sharing marks a sharp break from DRDO's historical secrecy and came with easier access to testing facilities and direct funding for defence start-ups.
questions.source: DRDO launched a framework to share weapon software source code with licensed private firms, a sharp break from its historical secrecy, alongside easier access to testing facilities and direct funding for defence start-ups.

questions.prompt: Consider the following statements about India's semiconductor and electronics sector as of September 2026:
items: India secured semiconductor commitments worth INR 1 trillion.
Applied Materials pledged USD 5 billion over a decade.
Domestic value addition in electronics had reached about 40%.
questions.ask: Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explain: Statement 3 is wrong. Domestic value addition in electronics still sits at 18 to 20%. The first foundries give global suppliers an anchor to build local operations, so later entrants can source in India rather than import.
questions.source: India banked INR 1 trillion (USD 10.4 billion) in semiconductor commitments, Applied Materials alone pledging USD 5 billion over a decade, with Tata Electronics anchoring a supplier park in Dholera.

questions.prompt: In September 2026, Tata Electronics was reported to be anchoring a semiconductor supplier park at which of the following locations?
questions.explain: Tata Electronics is anchoring the supplier park in Dholera. It forms part of INR 1 trillion in semiconductor commitments that India secured in September 2026.
questions.source: with Tata Electronics anchoring a supplier park in Dholera
